name: scrape_url
description: Scrape the comments or reviews from a supported public URL: Reddit, YouTube, Amazon, TikTok, Instagram, Trustpilot, the App Store, Google Play, Steam, Hacker News, Shopify product pages, and 20 more sources

name: search_reddit
description: Search Reddit for threads matching a keyword

name: search_youtube
description: Search YouTube for videos matching a keyword and return title, URL, channel, view count, and publish date

name: search_blind
description: Search Blind (teamblind.com), the anonymous forum for tech and corporate professionals, for posts matching a keyword

name: research_topic
description: Run the full research pipeline: search Reddit for a keyword and scrape the matching threads in one call

name: find_scroll_stoppers
description: Find the top-performing public short-form videos for a niche, product, or competitor and return each on-screen hook with its engagement metrics

name: find_creators
description: Find TikTok and Instagram creators or potential affiliates for a niche, product, or competitor, with follower counts and engagement

name: find_products
description: Search Google Shopping for product listings by keyword and return titles, current and previous price, star rating, review count, and seller

name: find_early_products
description: Rank product listings that may be in an early-adopter window using listing youth, recent buyer-intent discussion, and low active-ad saturation

name: find_competitor_ads
description: Find the ads a brand or competitor is currently running on Facebook and Instagram and return the live copy, hooks, angles, and offers from the Meta Ad Library

name: whoami
description: Report the connected Adlicio account, plan status, and remaining monthly research credits

name: list_history
description: List the scrapes and researches this account already ran across the dashboard, extension, CLI, and MCP, newest first

name: get_history_item
description: Read the stored comments of one past scrape by id

name: search_history
description: Search every comment this account has already collected, across all scrapes and platforms, by substring

name: start_deep_scrape
description: Start a background scrape of all available comments from one YouTube video

name: get_deep_scrape
description: Check the status and results of a background YouTube deep scrape by job id

name: scrape_facebook_group
description: Queue a search inside a private Facebook group through the user's own logged-in Chrome browser via the Adlicio extension

name: get_extension_job
description: Check a queued Chrome extension job by id, including private Facebook group searches and Amazon review pulls

name: create_brand
description: Create a brand workspace on the account, the same brands shown in the Adlicio dashboard

name: start_brand_research
description: Start the brand research pipeline for a brand: gather relevant customer discussions and build the core avatar and sub-avatars

name: get_brand_research
description: Read the brand research this account built: the core avatar, sub-avatars with their ad angles, and verbatim customer quotes

name: start_voc_report
description: Generate a voice-of-customer report from scrapes already in this account's history: buyer voices, ranked ad angles with hooks, and a word bank

name: get_voc_report
description: Read the voice-of-customer reports this account has built

name: get_audience
description: Read the audiences this account built: named bundles of subreddits, review pages, and channels used for research

name: list_tracked_sources
description: List the Listening sources this account tracks, each swept on a daily, three-day, or weekly schedule

name: add_tracked_source
description: Add a Listening source to a brand so Adlicio sweeps it on a schedule and collects new comments

name: save_script
description: Save an ad script into a brand's Scripts library on the account
